first.rationale: Shortening onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation while avoiding the margin and customer-quality risks of reacting immediately with discounts. Verify both the onboarding evidence and the strongest competing pricing evidence before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The confirmed prior result directly addresses the current completion decline and improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its acquisition and revenue gains came with a 12% retention decline and failure beyond the first renewal cycle. A controlled experiment preserves uncertainty about whether the earlier onboarding gains will replicate under current conditions.
